description: A narrow shopfront with its whole front wall folded open to the street and a counter running the length of it, nine stools, no tables. A steam hood over the range dumps a column of onion-and-bone smell straight into Marrow Street, and the smell does all the advertising. A paper lantern hangs where a sign should be, OYELARAN'S brushed down one side and a 9 on the other.
name: Oyelaran's
